#Citizens of Skyrim

The Aldmeri Dominion did not stop at the Red Ring. It is waiting, behind its treaty, for the provinces of the Empire to tear each other apart. Every Nord who dies in this rebellion is a Nord the Dominion will not have to kill.

Ulfric Stormcloak knows this. He fights anyway.

#Stand Together

The Legion is not perfect. The treaty is not just. But a divided Empire falls, and a fallen Empire leaves Skyrim alone against the elves.

Enlist with Legate Rikke at Castle Dour. Fight for a Skyrim that will still exist when the next war comes.
